import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
t = trips[(trips['fish_date_season']==2) & (trips['fish_date_doy']>=150) & (trips['fish_date_doy']<=182)]
t = t[t['yt'].notna()]
bucket = (t['fish_date_doy']//10*10)
g = t.groupby(['cls', bucket]).apply(lambda d: pd.Series({
    'yt_per_ang': d['yt'].sum()/d['anglers'].sum() if d['anglers'].sum()>0 else float('nan'),
    'trips': len(d),
    'total_yt': d['yt'].sum(),
    'total_ang': d['anglers'].sum()
}))
result = g.reset_index().rename(columns={'fish_date_doy':'doy_bucket'}).sort_values(['cls','doy_bucket']).to_string()
